Card Q&A.q: Does this card's "when an effect suspends this Digimon" also activate when it's suspended by an  effect?

Effect: [When Digivolving] If this Digimon is suspended, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When an effect suspends one of your Digimon, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
